title: Issue map: a click outside an issue's details card closes it, as in Maestro
summary: The issue map page closes an open card and clears the chain on any click outside it while the clicked control still works; clicks, drags and pans started in the card keep it; another box switches; hint text says click outside to close. Version 38.
friction: The issue-map page has no in-repo browser test harness, so click behaviour is proven only by out-of-repo browser scripts; the suite check reads page text only.
